Delete Ec VM Interface
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/intf/:intfId

Deletes a Cloud or Branch Connector interface within a specific VM based on the provided interface ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

intfId
int32
REQUIRED

The interface ID

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
